news.title: Skyroot partners With Exolaunch, HEX20, OhmSpace for 3-nation mission on second Vikram-1 test flight
news.description: Skyroot’s Vikram-1 second test flight to carry HEX20 NILA III and Skyroot SCOPE via Exolaunch deployer, with OhmSpace resistojet demo; date/orbit unlisted.

news.title: Mahua alleges BJP supporters attacked car, accuses cops of inaction
news.description: Mahua Moitra alleges BJP supporters attacked her convoy in Nadia’s Kaliganj; claims police failed to provide court-mandated security. Complaint filed, no arrests.

news.title: Railways cancels 39 trains, rejigs timings of 28
news.description: Indian Railways cancels 39 trains, reschedules 28 due to Cyclone Akvan landfall; Vande Bharat, express and MEMU services hit across Odisha routes.

news.title: HC clarifies no stay on ban on service charge
news.description: Delhi HC says there’s no interim stay on the ban on mandatory restaurant service charges; Centre can act against violators as appeals are admitted.

news.title: HC refuses interim relief to Sumit
news.description: Calcutta High Court denies interim relief to Sumit Roy, aide of TMC MP Abhishek Banerjee, in four cases; cites BNSS remedy as he is already in custody.

news.title: Sundarbans to Buxa, conservation lessons emerge at wildlife lecture in Kolkata
news.description: Kolkata lecture highlights Project Tiger origins, Indira Gandhi’s role in adding Sundarbans, Buxa reintroduction lapses, Ranthambhore revival, and need to protect other species.

news.title: HP min’s remark on Op Sindoor leads to furore at HP Assembly
news.description: HP Assembly saw clashes after BJP accused minister Jagat Singh Negi of derogatory Op Sindoor remarks; CM ordered senior-cop probe into Bilaspur girls’ deaths.

news.title: Instagram removes another World Hindu Congress video: Organisers allege bias, seek Maharashtra govt intervention
news.description: A dispute has arisen regarding Instagram's removal of promotional content for the World Hindu Congress. Organisers claim that their outreach to young Hindus has been undermined by repeated content tak

news.title: Gold's bad year is getting worse. Why its price keeps falling
news.description: Gold has fallen sharply from its January record as higher interest rates and a stronger dollar change the investment case for the precious metal.

news.title: Nifty claws back 286 points; Bank Nifty scales fresh all-time high on Auto, Banking surge
news.description: Nifty climbs 286 points, Bank Nifty hits new high amid auto/banking rally; IT slips as markets rebound on sector strength and macro cues.
